verdict.rationale: Alloy is an identity and fraud decisioning API platform, so an official CLI is a fair thing to ask of it, but the evidence pack never documents one. The SDK mention, OpenAPI document, llms.txt index and ReadMe "Try It!" panel are developer building blocks and documentation surfaces, not a CLI, so none of them earn credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
